Subject: Next steps & rotating demo slots (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Carlos -

Thanks again for taking time today - great to learn more about Acme Health's prioritization around latency for patient-facing features and the need for predictable unit economics across your EU and APAC regions. As discussed, the next step is a technical deep dive/demo with our solutions engineer so we can validate integration points (VPC, KMS, and model routing policies) and scope a pilot.

To make this easy for your distributed team, we often propose a rotating monthly demo schedule so each region gets at least one meeting at a convenient local time. Below are three proposed rotating slot templates (pick one and we can lock dates):

Option A - 3-week rotation (one meeting/week, rotate region):
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue/Wed 10:00-11:00 PT (13:00-14:00 ET)
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Wed/Thu 10:00-11:00 CET (09:00-10:00 UTC)
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Thu/Fri 09:00-10:00 SGT (01:00-02:00 UTC)

Option B - Monthly rotation (one meeting/month, region rotates monthly):
- Month 1 (US): 10:00 PT on a Tue
- Month 2 (EU): 10:00 CET on a Wed
- Month 3 (APAC): 09:00 SGT on a Thu

Option C - Fixed alternating windows (every-other-week rotates US/EU; APAC join as recording + two-hour overlap office hours):
- Alternate Tue 11:00 PT / Tue 17:00 CET + recorded deep dive + 2-hour overlap office hours for APAC attendees

Practical notes:
- We can provide a rotating calendar invite and record each session; recordings + a short summary will be shared to keep folks in sync.
- Attached is a short discovery recap and a proposed demo agenda so your team can flag topics/questions ahead of time.
- If you prefer, we can propose concrete dates for the next 3 meetings - happy to coordinate.

Quick ask: which option (A/B/C) feels best for Acme Health? If you have preferred days/times or blackout windows for Priya's APAC team, send them over and we'll adapt.

Thanks -
